{{Quote|Good to see some backup! We received intel that Death Watch have taken this area captive. They've demanded that we leave Carlac immediately, or they'll burn the entire village to the ground.|Mortar, to a Jedi Knight|<ref name="Skirmish" />}}
'''Mortar''' was a [[Clone cold assault trooper/Legends|clone snowtrooper]] serving in the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].

==Biography==
As part of his [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] service, Mortar served in the [[Skirmish on Carlac]], along with a [[Unidentified Jedi Knight (Clone Wars)|Jedi General]], [[Clone Commander/Legends|Clone Commander]] [[Wolffe/Legends|Wolffe]], and other members of the [[104th Battalion/Legends|104th Battalion]].<ref name="Skirmish">{{TCWA|Skirmish on Carlac}}</ref>
